notes.title: Roadmap for 2025-2026
notes.content:
Devlog & Roadmap — Magic Soldier
We've been working hard behind the scenes for almost four months to get the game back on track.

We're not going to lie to you: we've come a long way.


🔥 Over the last 4 months, we’ve been putting in a huge amount of work to get things stable again.  
Server crashes, client crashes, frozen players, broken quests, rollback issues with XP or inventory...  

Yeah, we went through a storm.



There’s nothing worse for creators than seeing their game — their baby — not working properly.



I’ll be honest with you:  

We’ve thought about **stopping everything** more than once.  

When we see around 600 registered accounts, but only 5 players connected... it’s disheartening.  

But we take a step back and remind ourselves:  

If those 5 people love the game, then there’s hope — others will too.



We faced bugs where we genuinely said:  

This one… we might not get through it.

And yet — we did.



Every single day, we work to make Magic Soldier better than the day before.  

We try to consider most of your suggestions, and believe me: every single idea is studied.  

Most of them have actually already been implemented.



🧑‍💻 Just as a reminder: we’re only two indie devs.  

That means Magic Soldier is developed entirely in our free time.  

We both work regular jobs. We get up at 4AM, work until 11AM,  

then after work we get back to developing until 10PM or even later.  

Our days are crazy long, but we do it because we love this project.



✅And today, we can finally breathe a little.  

We’ve fixed almost all the major critical bugs.  

The game is now stable, reliable, and ready for what’s coming next.

And speaking of what’s next…



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469210/05a6f48a0cf67221f833580512e3dee66fb15c52.png"]


🗺️Roadmap — 2025 to 2026
We’re planning a total of 6 content updates, and 2 major milestone updates (1.5 and 2.0) by the end of 2026.

Until patch 1.5, our main focus will be crafting and improving progression between levels 30 and 100.  

Leveling can feel too repetitive past level 30, and crafting currently feels too basic.

To address this, before our first major update (*Soul of the Weapon*), we’ll release two updates focused on:

- New dungeons

- New area

- New crafting professions/skills

- The Class Weapon Questline

⚔️ The Class Weapon will be the strongest weapon in the game at level 100.  



Max-level players — you’ll definitely want to complete this quest!


Patch 1.5 — Soul of the Weapon
- Crafting becomes more complex and rewarding (goodbye “1 silver stone = OP item”)  

- Start of the Ancestral Armor questline (available from level 100)  

- This will be the strongest armor for level 110 players

 🛡️ Like the Class Weapon, the Ancestral Armor will be extremely difficult to obtain.  

But it’s endgame gear — it should be earned.


Patch 2.0 — A Giant Leap
This will be a major leap forward — both in terms of gameplay and core systems.  

We’ll introduce three huge features we’ve dreamed about since the beginning:


Elemental Damage & Resistance
- Weapons, armor, and spells will have elemental stats:  

🔥 Fire, 💧 Water, 🌪️ Wind, 🌿 Earth

- These will be influenced by your elemental class

- Some monsters will be weak or resistant to certain types


Talent Trees
- Each class will get unique passives and spell choices

- This opens up real build diversity and deep customization


Passive spell
- Passive spells that grant bonus stats, effects, or boosts automatically  

- Strong synergies with talent trees and elemental builds

During Patch 2.0, you’ll also finish your full Ancestral Armor set.  

And by then, you’ll fully understand the importance of having both your class weapon and armor,  

especially as elemental stats become a core part of the game.


💬 Thank you all so much for sticking with us.The hardest part is behind us — and the best is yet to come. — The Magic Soldier Dev Team

notes.title: Patch Note 1.0.2 is online
notes.content:
Patch Note 1.0.2

Track Quest
A new feature is coming to Magic Soldier!

You asked us to be able to pin quests? We did it!

You asked us to have a more intuitive quest tracker? We did it!

In the next update, a new feature will be coming, and it will please new players (and perhaps even veterans!)

You will now have access to Quest Tracker, which will display an arrow below your character, indicating the shortest path (in theory!) to reach your objective.

Some details about this system:

- Some tasks will **intentionally** not be tracked.

- The system does not take walls into account! If the arrow tells you to go straight, but a forest or a wall appears in front of you, be smart and go around it ;)

The arrow will change color depending on the quest tracked.

We are convinced that this addition will help retain many more players during their first two hours of play.

I give you little footage on how work this system.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469210/75cb98c4274fe7bee706ac756abb28617a7bd4f4.png"]



Speaking of new players, we have decided to rework the tutorial to make it more epic, more engaging, and more comprehensive.



I won't spoil anything for those who want to repeat the tutorial, but I'll leave you with a visual :)

We will also be adding a tutorial for:

Crafting

The Battlepass

Daily quests + localization

How the title system, bestiary, etc. work


HUD Improvements
You will now be able to directly view your karma, as well as your experience and profession level, directly from the character window.


Selling in shops
A new button has appeared on each NPC offering to buy or sell. This will allow you to directly switch between buy/sell mode at the merchant, allowing you to also see all the items they accept, as well as their selling prices.


Quest icons have been revamped.
I mentioned arrow colors just before.

It will therefore match the new color code for quests above the character.

I'll let you see the visuals for the icons and arrows.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469210/329665f90d12ee37c1ba45bddb9498fe4ac4a5a2.png"]


Work Faster, Not Harder!
A new tab appears in the character window. It is currently disabled and will be available later.


Bugfix
- A bug related to crafting (impossible to exit crafting if the inventory is full) has been fixed.

- Bags in the hotbar now open the correct bag.

- Several small bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: ✨ Development Update
notes.content:
✅ It’s done! The changes have been implemented and everything’s running smoothly. Huge thanks for your patience and feedback 🫶 Here’s what’s been fixed and improved:

🛠️ Spell Latency
We finally identified the cause of the spell latency bug. The more enhanced gear a player wore, the worse the lag became — all due to a miscalculation in the code. That issue is now fully fixed, leading to smoother, more responsive combat! 🧙‍♀️✨

♻️ Energy Reset Bug
The bug that sometimes prevented energy points from resetting has also been resolved. You can now dive back into your instances without any trouble! (/reset) ⚡🌀

🖥️ New Server
We tackled a major server architecture issue, allowing us to migrate to a much more powerful machine. The result? Better performance, increased stability, and more room for all the wild ideas we’re cooking up. Dreaming big, as always 🚀

Thanks again for your amazing support 💖
Stay tuned — more updates are just around the corner!

notes.title: ✨ Dev Update - Sunday, April 13th from 6 PM to 10 PM (UTC+2)
notes.content:
🛠️ Spell Latency Issue
We’ve identified the cause of the annoying lag on some spells. Turns out, the more upgraded gear you had equipped, the worse the latency became — all due to a miscalculation in the code. This will be fully fixed in the next update, bringing smoother and more responsive combat! 🧙‍♂️⚔️

♻️ Energy Reset Bug
Another long-standing issue: energy points sometimes wouldn’t reset properly. We’ve tracked it down and fixed it — and this fix will be part of the upcoming patch. Get ready to fight in instance freely again! 🔄⚡

🖥️ New Server
We’ve resolved a major backend architecture issue, which means we’re now ready to move the game to a much more powerful server. You can expect better stability, faster response times, and room for expansion. We’re thinking big! 🚀

Thanks for being such an amazing community — your feedback and support keep us going strong ❤️
Stay tuned, the update is just around the corner!
